title: RFC005 §26.5 Training Conditioning Policy
$comment: Closed envelope for the artifact `conditioning_policy_hash` names. RFC005 §26.5: optimization conditioning is separate from evaluation mode; every run pins a conditioning_policy_hash and declares, per attachment, exactly one of gold_prefix / predicted_prefix_stop_gradient / versioned_mixed_policy. The mode is a required field with NO default: `gold_prefix` is the obvious choice for a teacher-forced exact-text canary and obvious is not ratified. The same section's prohibitions are carried as required const-false declarations rather than as prose: gold crops, regions, continuation edges, TablePlan and property values/applicability must not be production neural inputs, and oracle_diagnostic must not update product-ancestor weights. Declaring them inside the document puts them in the policy identity, so a run cannot claim a hash whose policy says otherwise.

attachment.$comment: Mirrors loss_unit.schema.json: `decoder_step` is the only attachment that exists in M1, and widening it here without a corresponding output would let a policy declare conditioning for something that cannot be conditioned.

mode.$comment: §26.5, the three ratified values, closed. No default.

allOf.$comment: 'versioned_mixed_policy' is only versioned if it names its version: the mixing rule must carry its own id and hash, exactly as §26.4 requires of a dynamic weighting algorithm.

gold_structural_prefix_teacher_forced_sl.$comment: §26.5 PERMITS this one: 'Gold structural prefix smie vytvoriť teacher-forced local slots počas optimization.' Boolean, required, not constrained -- declared either way, never assumed.

gold_input_prohibitions.$comment: §26.5's forbidden production neural inputs, one field each, every one required and const false. They are supplied by the caller rather than filled in here: a producer that wrote them itself would turn the run owner's declaration into this file's opinion.
